WITH RECURSIVE blocked(pid) AS (
               SELECT activity.pid
               FROM pg_stat_activity activity
               WHERE $1 = ANY(pg_blocking_pids(activity.pid))
               UNION
               SELECT activity.pid
               FROM pg_stat_activity activity
               JOIN blocked blocker
                 ON blocker.pid = ANY(pg_blocking_pids(activity.pid))
             )
             SELECT count(*) FROM blocked
